K-Modes.selection_rule: admissible, stable first; highest Gower silhouette, then resampling ARI

MCA + K-Means.selection_rule: admissible, stable first; highest MCA silhouette, then lower Davies-Bouldin, ARI, Calinski-Harabasz

Agglomerative.selection_rule: admissible (min cluster size); average linkage first; highest Gower silhouette
